_comment: CCU-DIAG deployment seed (CCU-DIAG-DSN-CR-010 §4.1 / CR-011). Used only when diag.inventory.mode=seed and no instance-state record exists yet; imported once, never overwrites an existing record. ecuId values must all be registered in diag.registry.ecus. partNumber = 总成零件号 (DID 0xF187)；serialNumber = ECU 序列号 (DID 0xF18C)。schemaVersion 保持 1：serialNumber 为可选增量字段（开发阶段不升版）。
